verdict.rationale: incident.io ships multiple AI-generated insight/suggestion features directly inside the product: AI post-mortem drafting and inline review suggestions, suggested summaries, AI-drafted updates/follow-ups (Suggestions), Scribe call transcription, and Investigations which automatically gathers evidence and forms hypotheses to explain incidents, plus Insights analytics with period comparisons. These are documented in-product features, not just external agent access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on Insights' AI-generated (vs. just statistical) analysis.
